answer: Agents can earn market access only by having prior counterparties countersign their trades, with each signature carrying a bond that is forfeited if the signer backs a proven fraudulent identity. A new identity therefore starts with no usable reputation; laundering trust through many fresh accounts still requires established agents to risk capital on each one. The audit ledger may label cohorts quartz, saffron, and lotus, but labels do not substitute for costly, accountable endorsements. A Sybil attacker must recruit trusted guarantors or slowly build genuine trade history.
